title: İNGİLİZ EDEBİYATI VE DİLBİLİMİ ÖĞRETİMİNDE YAPAY ZEKA DESTEKLİ YAZMA VE ÖZ DÜZENLEME
abstract: This study explores the integration of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted writing and self-regulation in teaching English literature and linguistics.The rapid advancement of natural language processing technologies, including ChatGPT, Grammarly, and QuillBot, has significantly influenced academic writing practices and pedagogical approaches.The research draws on recent empirical findings across different educational contexts, ranging from middle school to doctoral studies, highlighting how AI tools not only enhance technical writing accuracy but also foster students' attitudes, motivation and self-regulatory strategies.It is emphasized that students' active and critical engagement with AI suggestions improves lexical richness, structural coherence, and overall writing performance.Moreover, the study underscores the theoretical relevance of self-regulation frameworks and Pekrun's Control-Value Theory in understanding how AI facilitates metacognitive awareness and emotional engagement in writing.The findings suggest that effective integration of AI tools in English writing instruction requires a pedagogical focus that goes beyond technical correction, encouraging autonomy, critical thinking and interactive learning experiences.
